summary: Nano-X Imaging filed a 6-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Nasdaq notice that its ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, breaching Listing Rule 5450(a)(1)'s minimum bid price requirement on the Nasdaq Global Market. Listing continues unaffected; the company has until March 29, 2027 (180 days) to regain compliance via 10 consecutive closes at or above $1.00. Failing that, it may qualify for an additional 180-day grace period by transferring to the Nasdaq Capital Market. No response decision has been made; watch dilution risk from a reverse split or capital raise.
